[P2] Return to the required design phase for the public API additions

CONTRIBUTING.md rules 2–3 require a design note covering the problem, cause, alternatives including simplification, chosen option, and removals, with maintainer agreement before implementation. The supplied description explains the implementation and trade-offs but contains no alternatives analysis or reference to an agreed design note for this execution-wide option and the new semantics. Return to the design phase under rules 8–9 and obtain agreement on those choices before proceeding.
